name: zclass_typelist_process_pending_removals
description: zClass_TypeList::ProcessPendingRemovals removes pending links from one type-list bucket, preserves active queued-tree links, clears queued-tree flags when removing, and clears the bucket dirty flag.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this list helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass list/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x44e700 validates the deferred-processing guard, pending-link scan/removal loop, bucket 7 active-queued exception, head/tail/prev/next relinking, queued-tree flag clearing, free-link recycling, and dirty-flag reset.

The native smoke verifies pending removal from bucket 7, preservation of active queued-tree links, queue flag updates, dirty-flag reset, free-list recycling, and related type-list insertion/marking behavior.
